ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What happens if the weather changes?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Weather happens. If conditions are not suitable for your charter, our team will walk you through the available rescheduling options and coordinate next steps with the vessel provider. You will not be left to sort it out alone.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can you help us choose the right yacht?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: That is exactly what we do. Tell us your date, group size, and the kind of day you have in mind, and our concierge team will point you toward the vessels that fit best.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How far in advance should we book?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Weekend and peak season dates move quickly, so earlier is always better. If your date is close, reach out anyway and we will tell you honestly what is still open.
Premium beverages are already included in every experience, and champagne is part of the arrival. If you would like to bring something specific, just mention it when you reach out.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How does reserving a date work?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Once we confirm availability for your date and vessel, we send the next steps to secure it. The process is simple, and we guide you through each part.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What happens after we request availability?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Our concierge team reviews your date and group, confirms the right vessel options, and follows up with clear next steps. No long sales process, just a straight path to your day on the water.
